arxiv-2102-03589.title: Edgeworth approximations for distributions of symmetric statistics Thanks: 1 Research supported by CRC 701
arxiv-2102-03589.creator: Friedrich Götze 1, Mindaugas Bloznelis 1
arxiv-2102-03589.description: Abstract . We study the distribution of a general class of asymptotically linear statistics which are symmetric functions of N N independent observations. The distribution functions of these statistics are approximated by an Edgeworth expansion with a remainder of order o ⁡ ( N − 1 ) o(N^{-1}) .

arxiv-2209-01464.title: Recent progress in intersection theory for Feynman integrals decomposition
arxiv-2209-01464.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by *. High precision calculations in perturbative QFT often require evaluation of big collection of Feynman integrals. Complexity of this task can be greatly reduced via the usage of linear identities among Feynman integrals. Based on mathematical theory of intersection numbers, recently a new method for derivation of such identities and decomposition of Feynman integrals was introduced and applied to many non-trivial examples.

arxiv-2301-01050.title: Geometric theory of topological defects: methodological developments and new trends
arxiv-2301-01050.creator: Sébastien Fumeron ‡, Bertrand Berche ‡, Fernando Moraes †
arxiv-2301-01050.description: Abstract Liquid crystals generally support orientational singularities of the director field known as topological defects. These latter modifiy transport properties in their vicinity as if the geometry was non-Euclidean. We present a state of the art of the differential geometry of nematic liquid crystals, with a special emphasis on linear defects.

arxiv-2302-11001.title: Tensor enriched categorical generalization of the Eilenberg-Watts theorem
arxiv-2302-11001.creator: Jaehyeok Lee
arxiv-2302-11001.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jaehyeok Lee. Let b b , b ′ b^{\prime} be commutative monoids in a Bénabou cosmos. Motivated by six-functor formalisms in algebraic geometry, we prove that the category of commutative monoids over b ⊗ b ′ b\otimes b^{\prime} is equivalent to the category of cocontinuous lax monoidal enriched functors between the monoidal enriched categories of right modules over b b , b ′ b^{\prime} .

arxiv-2410-17896.title: Gradient-Based Meta Learning for Uplink RSMA with Beyond Diagonal RIS
arxiv-2410-17896.creator: Shreya Khisa, Ali Amhaz, Mohamed Elhattab, Chadi Assi, Sanaa Sharafeddine
arxiv-2410-17896.description: Abstract Beyond diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surface (BD-RIS) has emerged as an innovative and generalized RIS framework that provides greater flexibility in wave manipulation and enhanced coverage. In comparison to conventional RIS, optimization of BD-RIS is more challenging due to the large number of optimization variables associated with it.

arxiv-2501-07379.title: Eco-evolutionary dynamics of trait-structured, sexually reproducing interacting populations with time-dependent birth and mortality rates
arxiv-2501-07379.creator: Manh Hong Duong, Fabian Spill, Blaine Van Rensburg
arxiv-2501-07379.description: Abstract The coupling between evolutionary and ecological changes (eco-evolutionary dynamics) has been shown to be relevant among diverse species, and is also of interest outside of ecology, i.e. in cancer evolution. These dynamics play an important role in determining survival in response to climate change, motivating the need for mathematical models to capture their complex interplay.

arxiv-2502-11339.title: Why is the strength of a polymer network so low? Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2502-11339.creator: Shaswat Mohanty, Jose Blanchet, Zhigang Suo, Wei Cai
arxiv-2502-11339.description: Abstract Experiments have long shown that a polymer network of covalent bonds commonly ruptures at a stress that is orders of magnitude lower than the strength of the covalent bonds. Here we investigate this large reduction in strength by coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations.

arxiv-2509-24170.title: Sign and signed rank tests for paired functions
arxiv-2509-24170.creator: Mark J. Meyer
arxiv-2509-24170.description: Abstract Simple nonparametric tests for paired functional data are an understudied area, despite recent advances in similar tests for other types of functional data. While the sign test has received limited treatment, the signed rank-type test has not previously been examined. The aim of the present work is to develop and evaluate these types of tests for functional data.

arxiv-2512-17521.title: A cut finite element method for the Biot system of poroelasticity
arxiv-2512-17521.creator: Nanna Berre, Kent-Andre Mardal, André Massing, Ivan Yotov
arxiv-2512-17521.description: Abstract We propose a novel cut finite element method for the numerical solution of the Biot system of poroelasticity. The Biot system couples elastic deformation of a porous solid with viscous fluid flow and commonly arises on domains with complex geometries that make high-quality volumetric meshing challenging.

arxiv-2602-17363.title: 2Mamba2Furious: Linear in Complexity, Competitive in Accuracy
arxiv-2602-17363.creator: Gabriel Mongaras, Eric C. Larson
arxiv-2602-17363.description: Abstract Linear attention transformers have become a strong alternative to softmax attention due to their efficiency. However, linear attention tends to be less expressive and results in reduced accuracy compared to softmax attention. To bridge the accuracy gap between softmax attention and linear attention, we manipulate Mamba-2, a very strong linear attention variant.

pmc-10595748.title: Behind the screens: What underlies the experience of social media as a stressor among adolescents
pmc-10595748.creator: AIO Andersen, T R Finserås, G J Hjetland, B Sivertsen, J C Skogen
pmc-10595748.description: BackgroundSocial media (SOME) use has been linked to psychological problems in some studies, but the results are mixed. Digital stress may explain the link between SOME and mental health, but the underlying components that constitute the subjective stress experience that may stem from SOME use remain uncertain.

pmc-10693105.title: A multicenter noninferior randomized controlled study of sentinel lymph node biopsy alone versus sentinel lymph node biopsy plus lymphadenectomy for patients with stage I endometrial cancer, INSEC trial concept
pmc-10693105.creator: Yanglong Guo, Lu Sun, Xi Chen, Qiang Wen, Zhuyan Shao, Xuedong Tang, XiaoJun Shi, Jinyu Wang, Yingli Zhang, Tao Zhu
pmc-10693105.description: BackgroundUp to the present time, there has remained a lack of strong evidence as to whether sentinel lymph node biopsy can replace lymphadenectomy for early endometrial cancer. The traditional surgery for endometrial cancer includes pelvic lymphadenectomy and paraaortic lymph node resection, but complications often seriously affect patients’ quality of life.

pmc-12589196.title: Impact of fertility treatments on perinatal outcomes in pregnancies complicated by GDMA1: a comparative cohort study
pmc-12589196.creator: Tamar Eshkoli, Tal Atzmon, Reut Rotem, Adi Y Weintraub, Yael Baumfeld, Naama Steiner
pmc-12589196.description: ObjectiveTo investigate adverse pregnancy and delivery outcomes in women with GDMA1 during pregnancies conceived through fertility treatments.MethodsThis population-based retrospective cohort study examined adverse pregnancy and delivery outcomes in pregnancies affected by GDMA1 following fertility treatments compared to those conceived naturally.

pmc-12596017.title: Atypical Presentation of Toxic Shock Syndrome in a Patient With Postpartum Necrotizing Endometritis
pmc-12596017.creator: Tamar Megrelishvili, Elene Saribekovi, Elene Pachkoria, Tamar Didbaridze, Ia Mikadze, Levan Ratiani
pmc-12596017.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). A 42-year-old woman with a history of two first-trimester miscarriages and a known prothrombotic polymorphism (MTHFR C677T/A1298C compound heterozygote) developed postpartum toxic shock syndrome (TSS) complicated by peripheral skin necrosis eight days after emergency cesarean section for preeclampsia exacerbation. She presented with fever, hypotension, tachycardia, severe diarrhea, and a purpuric rash on the nose and distal lower extremities, rapidly evolving to necrosis. Although she had been prescribed prophylactic nadroparin during pregnancy, anticoagulation was discontinued upon discharge following the cesarean section.

pmc-12628505.title: Lesion location changes the association between brain excitability and the performance of a short-term visuomotor adaptation task post-stroke
pmc-12628505.creator: Bernat De Las Heras, Lynden Rodrigues, Jacopo Cristini, Kevin Moncion, Numa Dancause, Alexander Thiel, Jodi D Edwards, Janice J Eng, Ada Tang, Marc Roig
pmc-12628505.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The capacity to reacquire motor skills lost after a stroke is crucial to promote upper-limb motor recovery, but the impact of lesion location on motor skill acquisition and the underlying neurophysiological mechanisms remain uncertain. Cortico-spinal excitability, measured with transcranial magnetic stimulation, provides information about the functional integrity of the cortico-spinal tract, a structure essential for upper-limb motor function and recovery post-stroke. Cortico-spinal excitability is a biomarker that has been used to predict upper-limb motor recovery and guide interventions post-stroke.

pmc-13041006.title: Boosting lactoferrin yields in Nicotiana tabacum via HC-Pro co-agroinfiltration
pmc-13041006.creator: Mahbobeh Lotfi, Ali Niazi, Yong-Hong Liu, Behzad Shahin-kaleybar, Mandana Shariatzadeh, Farzaneh Aram, Bahman Fazeli-Nasab, Javid Ahmad Parray, Wen Jun Li, Apurva Sharma, Pankaj Kumar, Rozidaini Mohd Ghazi
pmc-13041006.description: IntroductionPlant-based recombinant protein production provides a safe and cost-effective method for producing functional medicinal proteins. However, transgene silencing, a natural defense mechanism in plants, often reduces protein production by causing transgenes to behave differently than expected. To overcome this issue, some viruses encode a Helper-Component Proteinase (HC-Pro) that can suppress RNA silencing.

pmc-13264302.title: Tocilizumab for the Treatment of Intravenous Immunoglobulin-Resistant Kawasaki Disease in Children: Two Case Reports and Literature Review
pmc-13264302.creator: Li-E Wu, Chun-Lin Huang, Jun-Yu Wei, Si-Liang Lu
pmc-13264302.description: PurposeThe treatment of intravenous immunoglobulin-resistant Kawasaki disease remains challenging. We report the clinical course and extended follow-up of two cases of intravenous immunoglobulin-resistant Kawasaki disease successfully treated with tocilizumab. This report includes a summary of the global literature on the use of tocilizumab for the treatment of Kawasaki disease.

pmc-13435269.creator: Jong Myong Park, Minjeong Kim, Chang-Gi Back, Ji Won Hong, Jin-Soo Son, Ki-Eun Lee, Jin-Won Kim, Hyeon-Ho Myeong, Young-Hyun You
pmc-13435269.description: This study was aimed at characterizing the culturable rhizosphere fungal community of Abies koreana on Mt. Jiri, Korea and to investigate the influence of topographic and physicochemical soil properties on them. Samples were collected from two contrasting sites: the Seseok Plateau (gentle-slope basin with poor drainage) and Oesamsinbong (steep slope with excellent drainage).
